functions.name: ForceShowProperty
functions.docs: Forcibly show the property, even if it does not have CPF_Edit

functions.name: AllowChildren
functions.docs: Override whether the property node should allow children or not. If not overridden the default is implementation defined.

functions.name: CreateCategoryNodes
functions.docs: Override whether the property node should create category nodes or not. If not overridden the default is implementation defined.

functions.name: UniqueId
functions.docs: Set a unique name for this property, allowing it to correctly save expansion states and other persistent UI state

functions.name: HideRootObjectNode
functions.signature: HideRootObjectNode(Target, In Hide Root Object Node)
functions.docs: Override whether the root object node should be shown for external object properties. This only applies when adding an entire uobject's properties to the details panel rather than an individual row or struct

functions.name: ShouldForcePropertyVisible
functions.docs: Check whether to forcibly show the property, even if it does not have CPF_Edit

functions.name: OverrideAllowChildren
functions.docs:
Conditionally overwrites the specified boolean with a value specifying whether to allow child properties or not.
Only overrides the value if the calling code specified an override

functions.name: OverrideCreateCategoryNodes
functions.docs:
Conditionally overwrites the specified boolean with a value specifying whether to create category nodes or not
Only overrides the value if the calling code specified an override

functions.name: GetUniqueId
functions.docs: Get this property's unique ID name
